WITH telescope_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    observstation,
    COUNT(*) as telesc_count
  FROM telescopes
  GROUP BY observstation
),
total_telescopes AS (
  SELECT CAST(COUNT(*) AS REAL) as total_count FROM telescopes
),
shares AS (
  SELECT 
    tc.observstation,
    tc.telesc_count,
    tc.telesc_count / tt.total_count as share
  FROM telescope_counts tc
  CROSS JOIN total_telescopes tt
),
avg_share AS (
  SELECT AVG(share) as avg_share_value FROM shares
),
above_average AS (
  SELECT 
    s.observstation,
    s.telesc_count,
    s.share,
    a.avg_share_value
  FROM shares s
  CROSS JOIN avg_share a
  WHERE s.share > a.avg_share_value
)
SELECT 
  AVG(telesc_count) as avg_telescope_count,
  AVG(share) as avg_share,
  AVG(share - avg_share_value) as avg_above_average
FROM above_average
